content:
• Fixed Oily Pocket. Previously, animations became very strange when exceeding 15 chips in hand. Now it's much better. Some animations may still need improvement, but overall it looks good: it creates 2 rows, and although the chips appear smaller, it's functional.
  • Promoted Card can no longer upgrade the rarity of unsellable cards. Additionally, when it upgrades a rare card that has a Pro Mod equipped, it will now automatically unequip it.
  • When exiting a run and entering again, the red Overkill text will continue to appear.
  • The same has been fixed for tube/tray/pillbox efficiencies. They should now save correctly.
  • The “Current: ...” text now appears for Yapa Card in the Memory screen.
  • Added maximum efficiency for colored tubes (8) and multicolor tubes (5). For Magic Pocket it's 6 and 4.
  • Added a tooltip showing the maximum efficiency for tubes.
  • Fixed a tutorial softlock that occurred when selecting chips.
  • Fixed Forbidden Cards appearance bug. It should now correctly unlock a Card slot and not destroy a card if it's unbreakable when there isn't enough space. This is still under review, but it should work better now.
  • After adding a new slot to a Supreme/Epic Card, when selecting a Pro Mod the glow now appears correctly indicating that the card can equip it.
  • Improved floating texts (texts that appear during scoring above the base and multi preview above the selected chips):
  • (1) Stacked Pink Tube floating texts (x1.5) (more than one with Last Drink Card) now reset their position instead of appearing higher each time.
  • (2) When two texts like xmulti and +multi (such as with Promoted Card) appear at the same time, they no longer overlap.
  • (3) Improved floating text animations, alignment, and speed.
  • (4) Improved floating text opacity; they now take longer before starting to fade.
  • BUFF: +35% chance for high-rarity items in Endless Mode.
  • Checked the Steam achievements system. I can continue adding in-game achievements beyond Steam's limit without causing crashes or needing to hardcode each achievement separately or implement a new system. If there's an in-game achievement that doesn't exist on Steam, nothing happens. This is good news, since it'll make it easier to add more than 100 achievements/unlockables even though Steam only allows 100 (for now, since the game needs to sell a certain number of units to unlock unlimited achievements on Steam). I won't stop creating new content. If you have achievement ideas, feel free to share them on Discord. Any crazy achievement could become real and even reward something unlockable.
That's all.

Remember: the game was released exactly 3 days ago, and until then only I had tested it for 6 months. I ask for your patience, and if you find a problem, please help by reporting it. I know it's annoying, but it's the only way to move forward faster. Sooner or later I discover every bug myself, but if someone finds it before me it helps speed up the process a lot. So far nobody has complained (even though some people have lost runs because of certain issues), so I appreciate the trust.

I also want you to know something else. I've seen that some runs are very hard to win. I'm aware of it and I'll soon make some adjustments to make them easier. However, if I see that in the future the win rate becomes too high, I'll do the opposite. I'll look for balance without fear of —ironically— unbalancing the game.

Please don't forget to join the Discord, or report issues in Discussions (the Steam forum section).

Also, I invite you to check the WIKI. If something is missing in the rules section, you can ask me to review/add things. I want all the game's rules to be clear.

I just fixed Tekano and Parrot Shell. These two cards literally didn't work at all since the game's release. My apologies in advance. The good news is that I fixed it as soon as it was reported—it was a really silly mistake. I'm committed to fixing everything that's wrong.

Fixes:
  • Hexagon collector card now also counts chips that are Ultrashape.
  • Fixed a visual bug where double boss tooltips didn't appear in the shop, specifically in endless mode.
  • Added minimum efficiency limits: Pillbox (4), Cookie Tray (7).
  • Added efficiency text to the Pillbox and Cookie Tray tooltips.
Card changes:
  • Lino: NEW → +1 pillbox efficiency
  • Start from scratch: +1 base → 1.5 base
  • Broken power scale: +2 base → +4 base
  • Separation: +2 base → +4 base
  • Club sandwich: +3 base → +4 base
  • Hexagon collector: +20 base → +25 base
  • Yapa: +5 base → +7 base
  • Blacksmith: $5 for any card → $3/4/5/6 depending on rarity
  • Mikello: +5 base → +6 base
  • The collector: +3 base → +4 base
Consumable changes:
  • One for all: +1 extra base → +3 extra base
  • Padlock: RARITY CHANGE! Epic → Rare
Changes in the information of the Rules section in the Wiki:
  • Rounds/Stages.
  • Card slots.
  • Money return when selling purchased items.
  • Pillbox and Cookie Tray efficiency.

• Fixed Outlay consumable bug. It didn't allow reuse for the entire run after being used once.
  • It's now possible to use multiple Outlays and have them stack the Extra Base on the first chip played. Previously only one per turn was allowed (this was intentional), but I'd like to encourage chip builds.
  • Improved discard animation. Remaining chips now move responsively depending on the sorting method instead of rearranging twice unnecessarily.
  • Sped up chip draw animations for smoother gameplay.
  • On the gameplay screen, when selecting a potion, the pocket tooltip will no longer appear.
  • From now on, the version text (main menu, top-right corner) will display the full version number including small hotfix patches (instead of only showing u4.0, it'll show u4.0.2).

• Fixed a screen freeze crash when receiving more than 13 draws (this is the default limit). Also, the Oily Pocket is currently visually bugged (it's playable, but the chips should resize correctly instead of overflowing the table).
  • Fixed a bug with sticker accumulation cards (their progress was not being saved/cleared), such as Glue Junkie or Kurosawa.

title: TEKO Early Access Launch!
content:
Finally. It’s here!
TEKO EA has just been released.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3835670/TEKO/
What does the new version include?
  • 96 Cards
  • 16 Pockets
  • 5 Levels for each Pocket
  • 10 New Bosses
  • 63 Achievements
  • Endless Mode
There’s still a lot of work ahead. For now, all efforts were focused on creating as much variety as possible in CARDS and POCKETS (they’re the two elements that bring the most hours of gameplay). Don’t worry about the current lack of stickers/consumables or the balance, everything will be properly adjusted as I continue releasing more content.

I have a lot to say after working on this for a year. But I think I’ll share those thoughts week by week. I don’t want to talk too much right now. I’d rather show that I can keep supporting this project in the long term.

We can agree that the game is already a complete experience. Even so, I’m ready to create tons of expansions. Stay tuned: there’s much more coming for TEKO!

Don’t forget that I’m open to feedback and willing to read all of your comments.
You can join the Discord server.
You can also check out the Official TEKO Wiki.
If you’d like to support the project, you can join the Patreon.

title: u3.2
content:
TEKO u3.2
'Outline' system reworked. Previously it was more like an 'Outglow'. Now every element has a solid outline when hovered or selected, greatly improving visibility. I also reworked all their colors.
Added a relief (button-like) effect to all in-game buttons.
Wobbly Card no longer deletes mods. If there's free space, they are restored after the card is removed.
Fixed 'Loudmouth' interaction, now it stacks previously played combos without needing to have the card.
The goal point deduction sound now plays earlier to better match the text animation.
Added Cam Mode: content creators now have a dedicated space for their camera in the top-right corner. This mode is disabled during the tutorial.
Changes to forbidden cards: their appearance rate was increased (from 0.1% to 0.25%), and when they trigger, they automatically unlock a card slot. If no space is available, they replace the leftmost card.
Fixed the tooltip description for the Empanada Race Pack in the Codex.
The Codex will now remain hidden for new players.
Codex item names were only showing in English, now this is fixed.
Performed several code optimizations to improve performance on low-end PCs.
Changed button colors in the main menu.
Fixed the 'Add Card Slot' button in the shop.
Changed the tooltip background color.
New adaptive text sizing system: all texts now scale responsively within their frames and share a unified size, creating a beautiful visual harmony.
Reworked all texts, now they all start with uppercase letters.
Improved the appearance of the Settings screen.

title: u3.1
content:
TEKO u3.1
Fixed music bug (the gameplay screen track was mistakenly placed in the sound effects audiogroup instead of the music one, causing multiple issues — an organization error).
The settings button now correctly appears on the screen after winning a round.
Fixed a visual artifact on the blender selection screen.
Now, when exiting and re-entering in the middle of a round, the remaining score will be saved. Previously, it unintentionally reset.
Made small adjustments to the overall OST gain.
The number of turns played in a round now updates correctly.
Fixed the rarity text of mods on the blender results screen.
Improved the description of the Profit Seeker Card.
Fixed tooltips in the pocket viewer.
Outlay consumable corrected, it now works properly.
Added more left and right click sounds. Empty spots are now less noticeable, as some buttons previously lacked sound. A few effects may still be missing, but it's much better now.
Created new logic to prevent click sounds from overlapping and playing multiple times simultaneously.
Compressed several files, optimized texture pages, and reduced image sizes. The compressed game now weighs 18MB, this is a great achievement.

Main Menu visuals reworked!
The scenery now includes clouds, the sky is darker, the horizon is flat, the road is better paved, Pixi was redrawn from scratch, and the Elite Tower is now more faithful to the canon (at night, it has a crystal-like appearance). The result is beautiful — I’m much happier with the main menu’s aesthetics. I’d wanted to do this for a long time. I also optimized image sizes: the menu went from 6MB down to 1MB.
